answer: Release earnings in terraces: each level unlocks only after the identity completes a fresh task verified by a stranger who never verified it before, and survives a random karst sinkhole audit that replays a slice of its past work from scratch. Copied work fails the replay and the whole terrace collapses, forfeiting its escrow. A farm's clones share one brain, so each clone faces its own sinkhole and fails alone; surviving several audits earns the haven terrace, where escrow is safe and pay doubles — a reward only real, distinct histories reach.
